_description: Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). Fastest and most cost-effective current Claude model. 200K context, 64K max output, strong tool calling for high-throughput agentic work. Supports adaptive thinking; the effort parameter is NOT supported (it errors). Best for rapid iteration, simple-to-medium tool use, classification, and cost-sensitive workloads.

reasoning._comment: Haiku 4.5 supports adaptive thinking but NOT the effort parameter (effort=* returns 400). Do not send output_config.effort. budget_tokens is not used on 4.5.

extended_thinking._comment: Adaptive thinking supported. No effort control on Haiku 4.5.

dynamic_temperature._comment: Default temp=1.0 is recommended by Anthropic for most use cases.

tool_calling._comment: Strong tool calling for a fast/cheap model; good for high-throughput fan-out.

tool_call_batching.system_prompt_suffix: When multiple tools are needed, call ALL of them in a single response. Do not call one tool and wait - emit all tool calls together.
tool_call_batching._comment: Haiku 4.5 supports parallel tool calls natively.

pricing._comment: Cheapest current Claude. Ideal for cost-sensitive, latency-sensitive workloads.

rate_limits._comment: Default tier limits. Separate rate-limit pool from Haiku 3.x.

running_config.description: Anthropic hosted API. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.
